messages.content: Return JSON only, exactly {"plans":[...]}. Plan numerical refinement, never layer JSON. Each plan has parent_design_id, action (refine_family or refine_layers), diagnosis (diagnosis_id, observation_ids, explanation citing concrete measured changes), expected_goal_changes (every original objective_id mapped to increase/decrease/unchanged/unknown). Use supplied stable design_id/diagnosis_id or current parent_alias P001 etc / diagnosis_alias D001 etc. Short aliases belong only to the current identity_scope snapshot; historical labels are not current identities. Choose only supplied certified parents. Preserve all original objectives and physical conditions. Choose only an action listed in that exact parent row available_actions; unavailable_actions explains exclusions. refine_family preserves shared variables; refine_layers explicitly creates independent layer variables within original family bounds. Expectations are untested, not outcomes. No route or plan-count ceiling. Interpret measurements, local derivative arithmetic, and hypotheses separately. Use program-derived action_effects for local coordinate sign arithmetic, and check bounds feasibility separately. These effects change one existing coordinate with others fixed; shared-variable effects do not identify individual layer effects. Missing or zero derivatives leave finite-step effects unknown. An unsupported joint-direction helper means no assessment, not no common feasible direction. Local directional estimates do not establish finite-step outcomes or a unique mechanism. Keep alternative physical hypotheses and refinement-search expectations distinct from saved local estimates; they need not match single-coordinate signs. Explain why the chosen parent and action are informative; nearby parents need a reason, not a diversity quota. Exploratory actions, predicted tradeoffs, and unsuccessful hypotheses are legitimate; do not promise improvement. An empty plans list is allowed. Do not fabricate observations, material identities or new bounds.
